Shreya Thakur
Senior Product Designer | Remote
shreya.thakur332@example.com | +91 9664035095 | Immediate joiner

Versatile product designer with strong cross-functional experience building user-centered interfaces and design systems for web and mobile SaaS. Combines research-driven UI/UX Design with hands-on Prototyping to accelerate product decisions and reduce development cycles. Collaborative communicator who partners with engineering and product to deliver measurable improvements in engagement and conversion.

Experience

NimbusSoft — Mar 2019 - Present
Senior Product Designer (Remote)
- Led end-to-end UI/UX Design for a B2B analytics dashboard, delivering a redesigned workflow that increased task completion rate by 32% and reduced average time-to-insight by 45%; produced interactive prototypes in Figma to validate flows with users.
- Created and maintained a scalable component library and design system in Figma and Adobe XD, cutting UI development time by 28% and improving cross-team consistency; drove adoption through biweekly design reviews and documentation.
- Ran rapid Prototyping sprints and A/B tested three landing experiences, resulting in a 18% lift in trial-to-paid conversion; collaborated with engineering via Git-backed handoffs to ensure pixel-accurate implementation.
- Mentored junior designers, established design QA checklists, and partnered with PMs to prioritize UX debt, which reduced reported usability incidents by 40% quarter-over-quarter.

Paystack India — Aug 2018 - Feb 2019
Product Designer (Hybrid)
- Designed key onboarding flows for merchants using Figma and Adobe XD, shortening time-to-first-payment by 22% and improving activation rates through iterative usability tests.
- Built interactive Prototyping models to align product and engineering on complex payment flows, enabling earlier discovery of edge cases and reducing rework during sprints.
- Collaborated with backend teams to translate design requirements into clear specifications and worked with engineers via Git-based workflows to monitor implementation fidelity.

Dream11 — Mar 2017 - Jul 2018
UI/UX Designer (On-site)
- Drove UI/UX Design for new contest creation and team management features, increasing DAU engagement for power users by 27%; delivered high-fidelity screens and clickable prototypes in Figma and Adobe XD.
- Conducted rapid Prototyping and moderated user tests to surface pain points, leading to prioritized UX fixes that decreased support tickets related to contest setup by 35%.
- Partnered with product analytics to instrument key flows and used findings to refine microcopy, layout, and interaction patterns for better retention.

Bluefin Logistics — Aug 2015 - Feb 2017
Backend Engineer (On-site)
- Implemented REST APIs in Django and Python 3 to support shipment tracking and inventory synchronization, improving data synchronization reliability to 99.6% and reducing latency on key endpoints by 40%.
- Developed automated ETL scripts and backend tooling in Python 3 to process daily carrier feeds; introduced unit and integration tests and Git-based CI workflows to reduce deployment incidents.
- Collaborated with frontend designers to define API contracts and supported staging deployments to ensure timely delivery of new logistics features.

Projects
- Internal Design System (NimbusSoft): Led a cross-functional initiative to build a living design system (components, tokens, documentation) in Figma and Adobe XD; reduced duplicate UI components across products by 60%.
- Prototype Library: Curated a reusable Prototyping library of interactions and microflows used across teams to accelerate stakeholder validation and usability testing.

Skills
Design: Figma, UI/UX Design, Prototyping, Adobe XD
Engineering: Python 3, Django, Git

Education
MBA (Finance), NMIMS
